[[File:Mk_III_Flak_Vest.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Mk III flak vest/Legends|MK.III Flak Vest]]]]
A '''flak vest''' or '''flak jacket''' was a type of protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn over an individual's upper torso.

==History==
The [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] wore flak vests during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] wore a similar flak vest, which was white in [[Color/Legends|color]].
